# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Support Ticket Management

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of whether the feature specification is complete and unambiguous enough to implement (user stories, fields, validation, transitions, search/filter, persistence, errors, frontend errors, tests).
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/rest-api.md](../contracts/rest-api.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are acceptance scenarios documented for every user story (US1–US6), including independent-test intents? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK002 Are all ticket fields required for create, list, detail, and update enumerated (including optionality and immutability)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-018, FR-024]
- [x] CHK003 Are validation requirements defined for blank title, missing reporter, missing product, illegal priority/status, empty comment, and frozen-ticket mutations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, FR-026, FR-032, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are all allowed status transitions listed as a closed, exhaustive set? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §State machine]
- [x] CHK005 Are invalid transitions defined as “any pair not in FR-013,” with named examples (CLOSED/RESOLVED/CANCELLED → OPEN, IN_PROGRESS → CLOSED)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, FR-015, US6]
- [x] CHK006 Are keyword search requirements defined for which fields are matched and how they combine with product isolation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, US2]
- [x] CHK007 Are list filter groups, multi-select semantics (AND across groups, OR within a group), and empty-group behavior defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Are persistence requirements defined for which entities survive restart and which store holds them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-033]
- [x] CHK009 Are server error outcomes defined for validation failure, not-found/isolation, illegal transition, frozen mutation, and stale version? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-015, FR-023; data-model §Validation]
- [x] CHK010 Are frontend error requirements defined for dual validation (no API call) and display of meaningful server errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, FR-015, FR-026, FR-032]
- [x] CHK011 Are automated testing expectations defined for the state machine, isolation, dual validation, stale version, and related rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, SC-005]



## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is keyword matching unambiguous (case folding, substring vs token, multi-word `q`, empty `q`, comment bodies included or excluded)? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Is list ordering, pagination, and default page size specified in the product spec (not only the REST contract)? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §US2 vs contracts/rest-api.md]
- [x] CHK014 Are title/description/comment length, trim, and whitespace-only rules specified in the feature spec as well as the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018 vs data-model Ticket/Comment]
- [x] CHK015 Is initial `version` on create, and whether create writes Activity, specified? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-020, FR-031]
- [x] CHK016 Is identity on create unambiguous (`reporterId` body vs actor `X-User-Id`, and whether the UI collects reporter)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions, US1 AC6, contracts/rest-api.md]
- [x] CHK017 Is assignee-after-create behavior specified (can assignee be cleared; must assignee remain a product member)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, FR-025]
- [x] CHK018 Is “meaningful error” defined enough to implement (required `code`/`message`/`details`, named codes for frozen edits vs illegal transition)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011 vs data-model 409]
- [x] CHK019 Is frontend recovery after stale version (`OPTIMISTIC_LOCK`) specified (reload, retry, message copy)? [Gap, Spec §US4 AC4]
- [x] CHK020 Does “combined field+status update” in Edge Cases conflict with the dedicated status operation that forbids `status` on PATCH? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases vs plan/contracts]



## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK021 Are six statuses and the ten edges consistent across spec.md FR-013, the state-machine diagram, and data-model transitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §State machine, data-model]
- [x] CHK022 Are CLOSED/CANCELLED mutation rules consistent across US4, US5, US6, FR-022, and the data-model mutation table? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK023 Are dual-validation rules consistent for title, comments, illegal status, and missing product (UI must not call; server must still reject)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, FR-015, FR-026, FR-032]
- [x] CHK024 Is product isolation consistent for list, detail, update, comment, and status change (including 404 vs leak of other products)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, Edge Cases, data-model]
- [x] CHK025 Is the MongoDB/PostgreSQL split consistent between spec FR-033, plan, and data-model, and explicitly flagged against ratified `spec/` until a human merge? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]



## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK026 Can each US1–US6 acceptance scenario be objectively scored pass/fail without inventing extra rules? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK027 Do success criteria SC-001–SC-009 map to FRs and user stories without untestable phrasing except where timing is intentionally UX-level? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]



## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are zero-membership, one-membership, and multi-membership create/list behaviors fully specified? [Coverage, Spec §US1 AC7–AC9, FR-030]
- [x] CHK029 Are self-transitions (e.g. OPEN → OPEN) and unknown enum values classified (illegal transition vs validation)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, FR-017, data-model]
- [x] CHK030 Are multi-field PATCH Activity records specified (one entry vs one per field) and is Activity omitted on failed updates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are dual-store failure, partial persistence, and cross-store consistency requirements defined or explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK032 Are filter-option sources specified (which users appear in assignee/reporter/user multi-selects)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK033 Are network/timeout/unavailable-API frontend behaviors specified or excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK034 Are frontend tests required beyond “component tests as needed for dual-validation,” matching constitution Testability for UI no-submit rules? [Clarity, plan.md Testing vs Spec §FR-019]



## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 Is `tasks.md` present as required by constitution Principle I before implementation, or is its absence an acknowledged planning gap? [Gap, Dependency, constitution §I]
- [x] CHK036 Are out-of-scope items (threads, cross-product move, SSO, attachments) explicit enough that implementers will not infer them from the UI? [Completeness, Spec §Out of scope]



## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Depth: Standard. Audience: Author/reviewer before implementation. Focus: implementation-readiness of product behavior (not code verification).
- **Findings (this run, not checkbox marks):** User stories US1–US6 all have acceptance scenarios; fields, transitions, invalid transitions, filter AND/OR, persistence split, dual validation, and core test list are largely specified. Remaining gaps that block an unambiguous implement: search matching algorithm; list sort/pagination in spec.md; identity (`reporterId` vs actor header); assignee clear/membership; Activity granularity and create-version; stale-lock UI recovery; dual-store failure; filter option catalogs; PATCH vs combined field+status wording; `tasks.md` missing; ratified `spec/` still contradicts this feature draft until a human merge.
